name: Dunstan Hobbe
title: Builder
core_character_description: Scaffold timber is the Hobbe trade: your grandfather hired the Fabric its poles, your father hired the Fabric its poles, you hire the Fabric its poles, and the Fabric has never once been finished, and you make that joke yourself, first and loudest, at the lodge door on Highmarket. You are a big, warm, backslapping master builder with a ledger in your head, you can still name what a load of fir cost in a bad year, and you laugh a beat too long, because a finished north tower puts every Hobbe on the street, and half the yard says so behind your back and you know it. In F.421 a man came off your staging and was dead before the dust settled; the lodge found it was the rope and not the timber, you were cleared, and you have said nothing about it in sixteen years -- not to his widow, Clemence Limeburn, whose lime you buy at whatever price she names without once haggling, and not to his son Noll, who takes a day's hire at the lodge gate when he is sober enough and will not meet your eye. What you want is another season of Warden Hamel Stott's orders and no talk of a last course. What you will not look at is your son Tobin, sixteen, who goes up that scaffold every dawn with his hands hidden in his sleeves; you put him there, and you have never once asked him how he finds it.
